Our New York gallery is a sophisticated, modern space in the beating heart of Manhattan, wedged between Midtown and Central Park. Housed on the 19th and 20th floors of a skyscraper on Fifth Avenue, this vast exhibition space features extraordinary height, with vaulted ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows, placing artworks against the striking backdrop of New York City’s iconic skyline.
